pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR 0125 VFX authoring workflow
pr_body:
## Summary

- completes typed VFX module property, curve, gradient, texture-sheet, and template authoring on top of the existing VfxAuthoringService
- adds deterministic VFX Builder preview controls, production CPU reference runtime integration, runtime stats, emitter-shape visualization, and live bounds
- adds shared-service VFX CLI and MCP inspect/validate/preview/apply/template surfaces with parity coverage

## Validation

Windows Validation and Editor visual validation are required for this change.
